M-5.title: public detail codes the closed registry cannot express
projectionRule: base code = text before the FIRST colon; the remainder is DomainDetail.subject
a detail whose base code is a registry member wins over the enclosing refusal (why ROOT.* are codes)
otherwise the refusal supplies the code and the whole detail is subject text (RECOVERY.REFUSED, CONFIG.CUSTODY_REFUSED, PROJECT.EXPLICIT_PATH_INVALID sub-details stay unregistered by design)
closed set of 191 members, not a prefix rule: a base inside the eight published families but outside the set REFUSES, so there is no PROFILE_SET.* wildcard
the D9 branch comes from the refusal, never from the detail
PROFILE_SET_KEY_NOT_MACHINE_ID is a SUBJECT sub-detail of the registered NT-TCB-PROFILE-UNQUALIFIED, not a code
